articles.title: Myanmar's army-backed leader says he is reconsidering ASEAN relationship
articles.description: ASEAN leaders have said they may consider gradually restoring Myanmar's full political representation in the regional bloc, if the country makes progress on their longstanding plan to resolve its crisis.
articles.content:
Following a 2021 military coup, ASEAN has excluded Myanmar from high-level meetings as it has yet to make meaningful progress on the bloc's Five-Point Consensus to end hostilities.

articles.title: July uprising memorial torched, crude bombs exploded in Tangail
articles.description: Vandals set fire to a memorial dedicated to those killed during the July uprising in Mirzapur upazila of Tangail on Wednesday night. The incident took place beside the Gorai Highway Police Station, near the Dhaka-Tangail-Jamuna Bridge Highway.
